_comment: Structures stored as .vox, painted only in block colours. y = 0 is the floor layer.

vaari_dome_house.note: Round riverside house: sandstone and plaster walls under a clay-tile dome. 7 m across.

watch_tower.note: Tapering round tower with a lookout gallery, like the ones over the river towns. 15 m tall.

reed_hut.note: Small round hut with a reed-thatch cone roof: fishers and herders. 4.5 m across.

ruin_arch.note: A broken gateway of the old builders: two pillars, part of an arch, moss, fallen blocks.

skyroot_tree.note: Flat-topped savannah giant with wide surface roots and crimson leaves. 12 m tall.

violet_tree.note: Crimson-wood forest tree: tall dark trunk, clumped violet crown. 11 m tall.

green_tree.note: Broadleaf river tree with a round green crown. 8 m tall.
